facts.fact: POTRAZ issued Starlink Zimbabwe (Pvt) Ltd a Telecommunication Licence for Network Services and a national Internet Services Provider licence on 6 September 2024, authorising internet services across Zimbabwe over the Starlink LEO constellation; distributors and ISPs are subject to POTRAZ clearance.
Techzim reports Starlink went live in Zimbabwe on 6 September 2024, the day of licensing, with kits sold through POTRAZ-cleared agents, dealers and ISPs.
